apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: productcatalogservice
  namespace: boutique
  labels:
    app: productcatalogservice
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: productcatalogservice
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: productcatalogservice
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: productcatalogservice
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 5
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
      containers:
      - name: server
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
              - ALL
          privileged: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        image: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/google-samples/microservices-demo/productcatalogservice:v0.10.3
        ports:
        - containerPort: 3550
        env:
        - name: PORT
          value: "3550"
        - name: DISABLE_PROFILER
          value: "1"
        readinessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          grpc:
            port: 3550
        livenessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          grpc:
            port: 3550
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 64Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 128Mi

apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolume
metadata:
  name: redis-cart-pv
spec:
  capacity:
    storage: 1Gi
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce # Redis 只需要 RWO 模式
  persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy: Retain # 允许管理员手动清理数据
  storageClassName: "" 
  hostPath:
    path: "/mnt/data" #集群节点
    type: DirectoryOrCreate
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: redis-cart-pvc
  namespace: boutique
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
  storageClassName: "" 
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: redis-cart
  namespace: boutique
  labels:
    app: redis-cart
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redis-cart
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: redis-cart
    spec:
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
      containers:
      - name: redis
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
              - ALL
          privileged: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        image: redis:alpine
        ports:
        - containerPort: 6379
        readinessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 5
          tcpSocket:
            port: 6379
        livenessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 5
          tcpSocket:
            port: 6379
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /data
          name: redis-data # 👈 挂载 Redis 数据目录
        resources:
          limits:
            memory: 256Mi
            cpu: 125m
          requests:
            cpu: 70m
            memory: 200Mi
      volumes:
      - name: redis-data
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: redis-cart-pvc

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: redis-cart
  namespace: boutique
  labels:
    app: redis-cart
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: redis-cart
  ports:
  - name: tcp-redis
    port: 6379
    targetPort: 6379

本 SOP 会退回 pod 级判断（当前工具面无法区分 pod 与 node 的延迟注入）。
只读诊断：本 SOP 不执行任何写操作（重启/回滚/扩缩容），也不做对外播报；
它回答"最可能的根因与受害对象"，处置与沟通由值班按 runbook 人工执行。
不覆盖 SEV1（需 incident commander 介入）与变更引发的问题（走变更回滚流程）。
输入是冻结快照：诊断结论对"快照时刻"成立，恢复后需重新取证。
R1 已知边界：PVC 的 requested size / accessMode 在本 benchmark 的工具面不可见，
因此 pvc_capacity 与 pvc_access_mode 无法区分（同一分数并列，交给 jev 或升级）。
